title: The Rule of Thirds in Layout
summary: A short guide to splitting a layout into thirds: where to put the base, the support and the accent so the page feels balanced.

keypoints.title: Understanding the dominant base
keypoints.summary: The dominant share of a layout should use a **neutral base** that gives the eye a place to rest. It keeps the page calm.

keypoints.title: The supporting color
keypoints.summary: The next share goes to a **supporting color** that is important but less prominent than the accent. It shapes the identity of the page.

keypoints.title: The accent for action
keypoints.summary: Reserve a small share for the **accent**, used for buttons and links that need attention.
